scope: EC3 §12.7.4.1 Table 227 bit 2 Required; §12.7.6.2, Table 240 bit 2 IncludeNoValueFields and submit-form invocation; current compose→core event/report→viewer-host policy path.

source_locators.table_227: EC3 Table 227, printed p.532 / physical p.547: Required says a set field shall have a value at the time it is exported by a submit-form action.
source_locators.table_240: EC3 Table 240, printed p.553 / physical p.568: when IncludeNoValueFields is set, selected fields shall be submitted regardless of value; a field without V transmits only its name; when clear, a field without a value is not submitted.
source_locators.submit_prose: EC3 §12.7.6.2, printed p.554 / physical p.569: the action's selected field names/values are transmitted upon invocation; the clause does not prescribe a hard refusal for a Required field without V.

current_path.composition: pdf-model/src/submission.rs::chosen emits an owed sentence for selected Required+no-V, and independently includes the name-only entry when IncludeNoValueFields is set. If the flag is clear, it omits the no-value field.
current_path.report: viewer-core/src/interact.rs appends Submission::owed to the outcome notes before it emits Event::Submit; the person is told the condition even when a submission is still composed.
current_path.host_policy: viewer-host/src/policy.rs::may_submit checks URL reachability and the owner's Submissions level (Refuse/Ask/Warn/Send); it does not reject because Submission::owed is nonempty. The test seam selects a policy outcome only; it performs no network I/O.

existing_assertions.evidence: A minimal fixture compares Required+empty, nonrequired+empty, and Required+filled, then checks the single Submission::owed sentence names the first. It does not exercise IncludeNoValueFields body output or viewer-host policy; it has no complete AcroForm DA/DR/AP setup.
Directly asserts clear excludes blank and set transmits blank with value None, but the blank field is not Required and the test does not inspect host policy.
Tests the four policy levels with composed submissions, but the fixtures have no Required-empty field; no existing assertion ties a nonempty owed report to those policy outcomes.

draft: drafts/required_empty_field_report_and_policy.rs exercises a valid PDF 1.7 widget/AcroForm with DA, DR Helvetica, NeedAppearances true, exact xref, required bit set, and no V/AP. It composes the attached SubmitForm action twice: IncludeNoValueFields set and clear. It checks the required-field report, parses the generated FDF to distinguish name-only from omission, and checks Ask/Refuse/Send at the host policy seam without opening a socket.
bounded_conclusion: This is not a confirmed ISO defect. The test input is a structurally valid PDF 1.7 form, but the Required-empty condition itself is deliberately unmet; do not describe this as fully conforming field content. Table 227 creates that condition, while Table 240 separately defines name-only transmission when the action includes valueless fields. The latter does not erase the former. Neither clause supplies a hard-refusal algorithm. Accepted ADR 1198 intentionally reports the unmet Required condition and leaves the host send decision/presentation to policy. The current coverage gap is the composition-diagnostic+body+host-policy combination, not evidence that the host must block transmission.
